items.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
items.message:
Higher than normal tides today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 10am today, Wednesday 28 October, and until tomorrow afternoon 

We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak. The weather forecast is improving, and we expect levels to start returning to normal soon.
We are monitoring rainfall and river levels.  
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water. 
This message will be updated by 10:00am on Thursday 29th October or as the situation changes.
